hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && HF_HOME=$PWD/cache/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_invariants.py 2>&1 | tail -15

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && b=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -oE 'worktree-agent-[a-z0-9]+|[a-z0-9-]+' | grep -E '^worktree-agent-|^h[0-9]+-' | head -1); [ -n "$b" ] || exit 0; echo "=== measurement-code diff in $b (read this, not the report) ==="; git diff --stat HEAD.."$b" -- src/lsx scripts 2>/dev/null | tail -20; git diff HEAD.."$b" -- src/lsx 'scripts/*extract*' 'scripts/*factors*' 'scripts/*selector*' 'scripts/*sweep*' 2>/dev/null | head -250

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo "--- open instrument risks ---" && grep -nE "still has no null|Next:|NOT narrowed|remains open|unre-run|untested" RESULTS.md | grep -v "^.*~~.*~~.*done" | tail -6 | cut -c1-200
